```yaml
name: Check Spy Versions

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Install required tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip ruby

      - name: Run spy version check
        run: ci/check-spy-versions.sh
        shell: bash
```
